def test_structural_palette_duplicate_delete_retains_live_state(self):
        self.page.check('#dev-hot')
        self.preview.get_by_role('textbox').fill('keep structural state')
        self.preview.get_by_role('button',name='Increment',exact=True).click()
        frame=self.page.frames[-1]
        identity=frame.evaluate('({root:appHandle.root.uid,input:appHandle.root.Input.uid})')
        self.page.locator('#dev-tree button').filter(has_text='#Panel').click()
        self.page.select_option('#dev-toolbox','CheckBox')
        self.page.get_by_role('button',name='Insert',exact=True).click()
        expect(self.page.locator('#dev-status')).to_contain_text('Hot reload 1',timeout=30000)
        expect(self.preview.get_by_role('checkbox')).to_have_count(1)
        self.page.locator('#dev-tree button').filter(has_text='#CheckBox1').click()
        self.page.click('#dev-duplicate')
        expect(self.page.locator('#dev-status')).to_contain_text('Hot reload 2',timeout=30000)
        expect(self.preview.get_by_role('checkbox')).to_have_count(2)
        removed=frame.evaluate('appHandle.root.CheckBox1Copy.uid')
        self.page.locator('#dev-tree button').filter(has_text='#CheckBox1Copy').click()
        self.page.get_by_role('button',name='Delete',exact=True).click()
        expect(self.page.locator('#dev-status')).to_contain_text('Hot reload 3',timeout=30000)
        expect(self.preview.get_by_role('checkbox')).to_have_count(1)
        self.assertIsNone(frame.evaluate("appHandle.root.FindControl('CheckBox1Copy')"))
        self.assertEqual(frame.evaluate('({root:appHandle.root.uid,input:appHandle.root.Input.uid})'),identity)
        expect(self.preview.get_by_role('textbox')).to_have_value('keep structural state')
        self.assertEqual(frame.evaluate('appHandle.root.count'),1)
        self.assertEqual(self.errors,[])
    def test_structural_reorder_moves_dom_nodes_without_reconstructing_controls(self):
        self.page.check('#dev-hot')
        frame=self.page.frames[-1]
        identity=frame.evaluate('appHandle.root.Input.uid')
        self.preview.get_by_role('textbox').fill('retain selection')
        frame.evaluate('appHandle.root.Input.element.setSelectionRange(2,7)')
        text=self.source('MainView.axaml')
        input_line=next(x for x in text.splitlines(True) if '<TextBox' in x)
        changed=text.replace(input_line,'').replace('    <Button',input_line+'    <Button')
        self.page.locator('#editor').fill(changed);self.page.click('#run')
        expect(self.page.locator('#dev-status')).to_contain_text('Hot reload 1',timeout=30000)
        self.assertEqual(frame.evaluate('appHandle.root.Input.uid'),identity)
        order=frame.evaluate('[...appHandle.root.Panel.element.children].map(x=>x.id)')
        self.assertGreater(order.index(identity),order.index(frame.evaluate('appHandle.root.CounterLabel.uid')))
        self.assertEqual(frame.evaluate('[appHandle.root.Input.element.selectionStart,appHandle.root.Input.element.selectionEnd]'),[2,7])
        self.assertEqual(self.errors,[])
    def test_structural_undo_redo_restores_namescope_without_restarting(self):
        self.page.check('#dev-hot')
        frame=self.page.frames[-1];identity=frame.evaluate('appHandle.root.uid')
        self.page.locator('#dev-tree button').filter(has_text='#Panel').click()
        self.page.select_option('#dev-toolbox','Button');self.page.get_by_role('button',name='Insert',exact=True).click()
        expect(self.page.locator('#dev-status')).to_contain_text('Hot reload 1',timeout=30000)
        self.assertTrue(frame.evaluate("!!appHandle.root.FindControl('Button1')"))
        self.page.get_by_role('button',name='Undo design',exact=True).click()
        expect(self.page.locator('#dev-status')).to_contain_text('Hot reload 2',timeout=30000)
        self.assertIsNone(frame.evaluate("appHandle.root.FindControl('Button1')"))
        self.page.get_by_role('button',name='Redo design',exact=True).click()
        expect(self.page.locator('#dev-status')).to_contain_text('Hot reload 3',timeout=30000)
        expect(self.preview.get_by_role('button',name='New button',exact=True)).to_be_visible()
        self.assertEqual(frame.evaluate('appHandle.root.uid'),identity)
        self.assertEqual(self.errors,[])
